nigeria.name: Nigeria

ghana.name: Ghana

kenya.name: Kenya
kenya.note: Cement, steel, blocks, sand, ballast, roofing, trusses, windows, internal doors, tiles, paint and pipe are Nairobi retail ranges. The external door is the bottom of a wide published range. Wiring, ceiling boards, the ceiling frame and several trade day rates are guides. Kitchen cupboards are a guide built from published per-metre rates. The septic tank, wardrobes, boundary wall and gate use the middle or the ends of a published range, and the plot size is the usual Kenyan plot for that number of bedrooms. Each line with a menu lets you switch to another point in the published range. Quantities follow published planning takeoffs for a simple Nairobi bungalow: about 4 to 6 bags of cement per square metre of floor, 2.5 to 4 tonnes of steel on a 120 m² house, plus the finish and the plot works. A published all-in band is shown separately because it includes a builder's overhead and does not itemise this wall.
